title: Dormi Students Guide
headline: Choose a course knowing where it actually leads.
purpose: School tells you what to study. It rarely tells you where any of it ends up. Dormi Students Guide closes that gap with events that put you in front of the work itself — the people doing it, the tools they use, and the routes that got them there.
shortDescription: For students still in school, weighing up where it all leads. School tells you what to study; it rarely tells you where any of it ends up. These events put you in front of the work itself.

eventFormats.name: Career Path Conferences
eventFormats.description: Sit with people already doing the job — engineers, nurses, designers, tradespeople — and hear what the work is really like before you commit three years to a programme.

eventFormats.name: Talent Showcases & Festivals
eventFormats.description: A stage for what you are good at outside the classroom. Music, dance, spoken word, design — seen by people who work in those industries.

eventFormats.name: Technical & Craft Expos
eventFormats.description: Hands on the tools of the trade. Welding, tailoring, catering, coding — try the work before you choose the course.

title: Dormi Graduates Guide
headline: The gap between finishing and starting.
purpose: The stretch between leaving school and starting work is where a great deal of potential quietly stalls. Dormi Graduates Guide is built for exactly that stretch — the applications, the first interviews, and the life admin nobody sat you down to explain.
shortDescription: For graduates with the certificate in hand and the next step unclear. The stretch between leaving school and starting work is where a great deal of potential quietly stalls, and these events are built for exactly that stretch.

eventFormats.name: Job Readiness & Placement Fairs
eventFormats.description: Employers with live vacancies in one hall, with CV surgeries and mock interview rooms running alongside. You leave with applications in, not a bag of leaflets.

eventFormats.name: Adulting & Life Planning Roundtables
eventFormats.description: Rent, tax, savings, family expectations, and learning to say no. Small groups, frank conversation, nobody pretending they have it worked out.

eventFormats.name: Personal Branding & Tech Bootcamps
eventFormats.description: Build the profile that gets you shortlisted, and the practical digital skills that keep you in the room once you are.

title: Dormi Workers Guide
headline: Getting the job is not the finish line.
purpose: Landing the role is one thing; lasting in it is another. Dormi Workers Guide is for the years afterwards — protecting your health, your money and your rights while you build something that holds.
shortDescription: For people in the job and building a life around it. Landing the role is one thing; lasting in it is another. These events protect your health, your money and your rights while you build something that holds.

eventFormats.name: Financial Stability Masterclasses
eventFormats.description: Real numbers rather than principles. Budgeting on an irregular income, building a buffer, clearing debt, and how the pension scheme actually pays out.

eventFormats.name: Workplace Wellness Retreats
eventFormats.description: Time away from the desk to deal with what the job quietly costs you — sleep, stress, and the habit of working straight through it.

eventFormats.name: Labour Rights Forums
eventFormats.description: What your contract actually entitles you to, what to do when it is ignored, and who to call. Led by people who know the law.

title: Dormi Entrepreneur Guide
headline: Starting is the easy part.
purpose: Starting something in Ghana is the easy part; keeping it alive is the work. Dormi Entrepreneur Guide brings founders together with funders, operators and one another — to get businesses funded, structured and ready to scale.
shortDescription: For people building something of their own. Starting something in Ghana is the easy part; keeping it alive is the work. These events bring founders together with funders, operators and one another.

eventFormats.name: Pitch Competitions & Investor Mixers
eventFormats.description: Six minutes in front of people who actually write cheques, live feedback from the panel, and structured introductions once the pitching is done.

eventFormats.name: Business Model & Scaling Intensives
eventFormats.description: Working sessions on the unglamorous parts — pricing, margins, supply, and the systems that let a business grow without breaking.

eventFormats.name: Leadership & Team Management Summits
eventFormats.description: Hiring your first staff, paying them properly, and learning to lead a team rather than quietly do everything yourself.
